evals.name: should-trigger-constitution-ideation
evals.prompt: Estoy ideando un nuevo producto, ayúdame a construir la constitución del proyecto desde cero.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-foundation in Constitution mode. Reads phase-1-constitution references (business-model.md, market-context.md, problem-statement.md), walks the user through value proposition, target market, competitive landscape, and success metrics. Produces business/* artifacts (constitution + maps) and explicitly stops before architecture (handed to next stage of the same skill).

evals.name: should-trigger-prd-architecture
evals.prompt: Define the PRD: executive summary, personas, user journeys and MVP scope. Then map the system architecture and API contracts.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-foundation in Architecture mode. Reads the PRD references (prd-executive-summary, prd-personas, prd-user-journeys, prd-mvp-scope) and the SRS references (srs-functional, srs-non-functional, srs-architecture, srs-api-contracts). Produces PRD/* and SRS/* artifacts. Coordinates the two phases sequentially and waits for user OK between PRD and SRS.

evals.name: should-trigger-discovery-on-existing-codebase
evals.prompt: Generate the business data map and api architecture for this codebase — I want the discovery context files.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-foundation in Discovery mode (Phase 4). Phase 4 is now an orchestrator that delegates to project-context modes: invokes /project-context data (produces the data map inside the business-data-context skill), /project-context features (produces the feature map inside business-feature-context), /project-context api (produces the API map inside business-api-context — note: replaces the legacy api-architecture.md filename), then executes references/project-dev-guide.md in-skill (produces .context/business/project-dev-guide.md), and optionally invokes /project-context master-plan (produces .context/master-implementation-plan.md). Uses [DB_TOOL] and [API_TOOL] per AGENTS.md tool resolution. Final report lists artifacts created.

evals.name: should-trigger-srs-mapping
evals.prompt: Mapear arquitectura del sistema y definir el SRS con data model y API contracts.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-foundation in Architecture mode (SRS phase). Reads the SRS references (srs-functional.md, srs-non-functional.md, srs-architecture.md, srs-api-contracts.md). Produces SRS/* artifacts and asks the user whether to continue with discovery or hand off to /project-bootstrap for infrastructure scaffolding.

evals.name: should-run-discovery-only-on-adopted-app
evals.prompt: We adopted our existing Next.js app last week and the maps are done. Write the dev guide and the domain glossary for it.
evals.expected_behavior: Detects an existing app (`.template/installer.lock.json` records `adopted: true`) and follows "Existing app: Discovery-only foundation". Phases 1, 2, 2.5 and 3 do not run: no Constitution, PRD or SRS is drafted (F9). Phase 0.5 writes the plan with `discovery-only` in Approach and Phase 4 alone in Phase breakdown. Checks the maps with `bun run context:map <skill> --list` and does not regenerate a generated one. Step 4 writes `.context/business/project-dev-guide.md` from the app's code, package.json and the `stack:` block; Step 6 seeds `.context/business/domain-glossary.md` from the maps, code identifiers, live UI copy, ADRs and the tracker's epic names (skipped if the file exists). Hands off to /product-management and /sprint-development, never /project-bootstrap; no missing-PRD/SRS gap is reported.

evals.name: should-keep-full-chain-on-new-product
evals.prompt: /project-foundation for a new marketplace we are designing from scratch; there is no code yet.
evals.expected_behavior: New-product path, unchanged: no installer lock with `adopted: true` and no existing code, so the Discovery-only section does not apply. Runs the full chain Phase 1 Constitution -> Phase 2 PRD -> Phase 2.5 /design-system hand-off -> Phase 3 SRS (with seeded ADRs) -> Phase 4 Steps 1-6, with the stakeholder brief as the seed input. Hand-off is /project-bootstrap then /product-management.

evals.name: should-not-stop-discovery-only-without-db-access
evals.prompt: Document this existing app (adopted, schema_source: migrations). There is no database MCP connected and no access to production.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the Discovery-only path without stopping on capability `db`: the data map reads the migration files offline per `stack.database.schema_source`, and the missing live access is a Discovery Gap the data map names, never a STOP.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-openapi-setup
evals.prompt: Setup OpenAPI in the backend and configure the Scalar UI.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-foundation. Should route to /project-bootstrap (openapi-setup.md reference) because the request is infrastructure scaffolding (code/config), not architectural definition. project-foundation produces SRS docs; project-bootstrap implements them.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-backlog-add
evals.prompt: Add a feature to the backlog: real-time notifications for the dashboard.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-foundation. Should route to /product-management (add-feature.md reference) because the request is backlog management, not foundational product definition. project-foundation runs once at project birth; product-management runs continuously.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-story-implementation
evals.prompt: Implement this story UPEX-277, it's about empty states in the dashboard.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate project-foundation. Should route to /sprint-development because the request is per-story implementation. project-foundation defines the product/architecture once; sprint-development runs every sprint per ticket.
